Mr. A.M. Nawaratne Bandara, Kadawathkelaya, Walpola, Bamunakotuwa. and
Sri Lanka Transport Board, No. 200, Kirula Road, Colombo 05.
STATEMENT OF MATTER IN DISPUTE
The matter in dispute between the aforesaid parties is

Whether Mr. A.M. Nawarathne Bandara working in the wariyapola Depot of the Sri Lanka Transport Board is entitled to receive the basic salary of Rs. 31,090.00 due for 01.01.2020 in accordance with the letter issued by the Board dated 20.06.2019 and if so, to what releif he is entitled.
H. K. K. A. JAYASUNDARA, Commissioner General of Labour.
Dated at the ofﬁ ce of the Commissioner General of Labour.Colombo, this 10th day of February 2025.

NOW THEREFORE I, Dr. Anil Jayantha Fernando, Minister of Labour do by virtue of the powers vested in me by Section 4 (1) of the Industrial Disputes Act, Chapter 131 of the Legislative Enactments of Ceylon (1956 Revised Edition), as amended by Act Nos. 14 of 1957, 4 of 1962 and 39 of 1968 (read with Industrial Disputes - Special Provisions) Act, No. 37 of 1968 hereby appoint of Mr. R.Navodayam, Attorney-at-Law of No. 411/16, Galle Road, Bambalapitiya, Colombo 04 to be the arbitrator and refer the aforesaid dispute to him for settlement by arbitration. Mrs. S.A.R.P. Samarasinghe, Kawudugama, Hettimulla. and
Kelani Valley Plantation Company Limited, Lavent Watta, Yatiyantota.
STATEMENT OF MATTER IN DISPUTE
The matter in dispute between the aforesaid parties is

Whether Mrs. S.A.R.P. Samarasinghe, who should have been reinstated in employment from 01.04.2019 as per Labour Tribunal order (KE/42/824/2012) had been caused injustice by not being placed in the due salary scale when she was reinstated in employment on 15.02.2021 following the order of the High Court (HC Kegalle Case No. 5508/2019/Appeal) of Sabaragamuwa Province and if so, to what releif she is entitled.
H. K. K. A. JAYASUNDARA, Commissioner General of Labour.
